slots.rationale: R30: 'after daily Mass' can't apply to Sunday, which has only the 7:30, 9:30 and 11:30 AM Masses. The website names no Adoration. Leaning to the start after the last Sunday Mass (POLICY: one hour after a weekend Mass), since any reading of 'after Mass, until 8:00 PM' covers 12:30-8:00 PM; 8:30 AM would claim Adoration during the later Masses.

slots.rationale: R30: the start comes only by reading the line's 'after daily Mass' as carrying over to Saturday (8:00 AM Mass, so 8:30 per R10); the Miraculous Medal Novena also follows that Mass ('Saturdays, following 8:00 AM Mass'). The end runs until a Mass with no clock time, so POLICY records no end_time; Saturday confession (2:45-3:45 PM) suggests it may end before 4:00. gpt-6-luna read 8:30 AM-4:00 PM, quoting 'Saturday—after daily Mass—until Vigil Mass', but both issues' p1 (re-read at 300 dpi) print only 'Saturday—until Vigil Mass.' Leaning to include from 8:30 with no end.
